events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, leading to increased geopolitical instability in the Middle East. This has resulted in a surge in oil prices and a decline in global stock markets. The US has shown military strength, but its waning geopolitical power is a concern.
events.reasoning: The Iran war escalation has led to increased oil prices, making oil services ETFs like OIH a potential buy. On the other hand, the decline in global stock markets makes the S&P 500 ETF a potential short.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and global stock markets

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or global stock markets rebound

events.title: Nvidia Earnings Report
events.summary: Nvidia's earnings report has signaled strong AI momentum, leading to a surge in AI-related stocks. The company's CFO has revealed strong GPU demand, making Nvidia a potential buy.
events.reasoning: Nvidia's strong earnings report and GPU demand make it a potential buy. Rotating into the semiconductor ETF SMH can also provide exposure to the AI trend.

timeFrame.note: Monitor Nvidia's stock price and AI-related news

events.exitStrategy: Exit when Nvidia's stock price reaches $300 or AI-related news becomes negative

events.title: US Interest Rate Hike
events.summary: The US Federal Reserve is expected to hold interest rates steady due to the oil shock, but may hike rates in the future. This has led to a decline in mortgage rates and an increase in consumer sentiment.

actions.label: SHORT
actions.target: SPDR Bloomberg Barclays High Yield Bond ETF (JNK)

events.reasoning: The expected interest rate hike makes long-term Treasury bonds like TLT a potential buy. On the other hand, high-yield bonds like JNK may decline in value, making them a potential short.

timeFrame.note: Monitor interest rates and bond yields

events.exitStrategy: Exit when interest rates rise or bond yields increase
